questions.topic: PrepLadder · 81.INTERSTITIAL LUNG DISEASE AND PULMONARY ALVEOLAR PROTEINOSIS
questions.stemHtml: A 50-year-old man who has worked in the glass manufacturing industry for over 20 years presents with progressive dyspnea, a chronic dry cough, and fatigue. On examination, he has bilateral crackles on auscultation. A high-resolution CT scan reveals a crazy-paving pattern in the lungs. What is the most likely cause of his condition?
